text.p: - Unemployment in Switzerland rose by 2,119 in August. The unemployement rate remained at 4.5 percent.
- Italian president Oscal Luigi Scalfaro will arrive tomorrow for an official state visit.
- Suedelektra Holding AG posted a decline in group profit to $19.5 million for the first six months of 1996.
- The life expectancy for Swiss 74 years for men and 81 years for women, according to new statistics.
- Private companies offering access to the Internet protested the Swiss Telecom PTT's special low "local" rate access offer that should go into effect on September 16.
- Some 1.9 percent less energy was used and 1.2 million fewer tonnes of carbon dioxide emission emitted in Switzerland in 1995 as compared to 1994.
